text: Yale's weighted_etr is an EFFECTIVE statutory rate (post mutual-exclusion stacking and USMCA/FTA/exemption reductions) on FIXED 2024 consumption-import weights. Our current counterpart is the ex-post collections rate on CONTEMPORANEOUS weights; the constructs differ on both axes, and the fixed-vs-contemporaneous gap is mechanical (imports of high-tariff goods contract, so a fixed-base statutory rate sits above a contemporaneous collections rate). Same-construct replication (our rates x fixed 2024 weights) is the planned stage-1 counterpart.
